summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return for Hong Kong Stock Exchange listing. The filing details share buybacks for cancellation on multiple dates in May and June 2026, with prices ranging from approximately USD 6.67 to USD 7.25 per share, and settlement of restricted share units on June 18, 2026, resulting in a net increase in issued shares. The buybacks represent ongoing capital return to shareholders. The filing is routine and specific to Hong Kong listing rules; the US equivalent is a Form 6-K. Watch for continued repurchase activity and cancellation timing.
